primary_question: does a JM (2-state jump model) regime signal let a global Sharpe-decay selector pick parameters with LOWER Sharpe decay than the same selector without regime conditioning, on a fixed common calendar? A sufficient reduction is accepted even if decay stays positive or OOS Sharpe stays negative.
primary_metric: Sharpe ratio and Sharpe decay (D = SR_IS - SR_FWD), in Sharpe points -- NOT mean-return/day, bps/day or any daily-return-based statistic. This is a metric-definition change from the parent FP study.

arms.A_M4: stock Mode 4 real selection from QuantBT (optimization_mode=mode_4_is_only_robust, optimization_schedule=per_fold_causal, candidate_selection_metric=is_only_robust, scoring_backend=endpoint) -- no Sharpe-decay model, fixed common calendar
arms.B_SD_GLOBAL: global ridge regression predicting relative Sharpe decay Y_hat from candidate/IS descriptors, over the FULL eligible candidate pool at each cutoff (not a 16-medoid subset) -- same fixed calendar as A
arms.C_SD_JM: B_SD_GLOBAL plus a JM(K=2)-state-conditioned residual correction with shrinkage toward global; evaluated independently of B's admission/fallback status every model-ready fold -- same fixed calendar as A

explicitly_excluded_this_round: dynamic refit timing, random-delay or volatility-delay overlay (FP-09's own mechanism is NOT continued or extended here)
K3/K4/HMM/HSMM/deep-learning regime sweep (JM K=2 only, max 3 jump-penalty designs)
a 4th phase (SD-04) or any model-family hunt for a positive result

primary_hypothesis.estimand: mean paired signed reduction R_bar = mean(D_B - D_C) over >=12 common folds
primary_hypothesis.safeguard: mean paired standardized forward Sharpe difference Q_bar(C-B) vs non-inferiority margin -0.10

secondary_hypotheses.role: key secondary, about the selector itself
secondary, total policy vs stock baseline
